command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
{ echo "uname_m $(uname -m)"; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; grep -m1 'CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; echo "cpus_online $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null)"; echo "thread_siblings_cpu0 $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list 2>/dev/null)"; awk -F: '/^siblings/{s=$2} /^cpu cores/{c=$2} END{if(c) print "threads_per_core", s/c}' /proc/cpuinfo; command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1 && lscpu | grep -i -E 'thread|core|socket'; } > /tmp/topology.txt 2>&1 || true
# ^ the chip legs' topology record: it describes the box and cannot fail the run.
echo '== freebayes, whole chr20, NA12878 at 36x =='
T0=$(date +%s)
freebayes -f chr20.fa -r chr20 NA12878.chr20.30x.bam > freebayes.vcf 2> fb.log
T1=$(date +%s)
N=$(grep -vc '^#' freebayes.vcf || true)
SM=$(awk '/^#CHROM/{print $10; exit}' freebayes.vcf)
NONCHR=$(awk '!/^#/ && $1!="chr20"' freebayes.vcf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
{ echo "wall_s          $(( T1 - T0 ))"; echo "variants        $N"; echo "sample          $SM  want NA12878"; echo "off_chr20       $NONCHR  want 0"; } > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
gzip -c freebayes.vcf > freebayes.vcf.gz
test "$SM" = 'NA12878'
test "$NONCHR" -eq 0
test "$N" -gt 50000
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
